page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.12xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T24 processor running at 2.7 GHz, delivering 24 physical cores and 48 vCPUs via dedicated CPU allocation. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong performance profiles across multiple domains. The CPU demonstrates strong single-core and multi-core capabilities, placing in the top 25% in stress-ng and Geekbench evaluations. Memory performance is highly competitive, with Passmark memory scores reaching the top 10% tier and cached read-only small block memory bandwidth measured at 3647.99 GB/sec. However, uncached large-block read and write memory bandwidths fall into the average tier at 111.38 GB/sec and 83.58 GB/sec, respectively. Cryptographic and vector instruction capabilities are supported by hardware flags including AVX-512 and AES.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density, the instance offers reliable performance scaling for production workloads without resource contention. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which is a key architectural tradeoff to consider. This server is well-suited for database operations, software compilation, multi-threaded decompression, and general-purpose web serving applications.
